words.gloss: those who shrink in shame from

literal: Those who shrink in shame from lack of equity will not do disgraceful deeds, coveting the accruing benefit.
translation: Those who shrink in shame from unfairness will not commit disgraceful deeds, even for the sake of gaining some benefit.
modern: நடுவுநிலைமை இல்லாத தன்மையைக் கண்டு வெட்கப்படுபவர்கள், தமக்குக் கிடைக்கும் பயனை விரும்பிப் பழி தரும் செயல்களைச் செய்ய மாட்டார்கள்.
explanation: This couplet highlights the integrity of those who value justice. People who feel a deep sense of shame at the very thought of being unfair or inequitable (natuvanmai nanupavar) will never commit disgraceful acts (palippatuva ceyyar). Even when they desire the potential gains or benefits (patupayan vehki) that could arise from an action, their moral conscience prevents them from choosing a path of dishonor.
